decisions.reason: The existing same-message Event defines the variants but omits that they are variants of the selected final design rev4-02.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi, oops I thought I’d got back to you!

We’d like to go agreed with that final version (above) - rev4-02. Thank you!

I’m assuming the logo would be with and without the black box (as a black box won’t work for everything)?

And we would get all colour variants you have shown?

However, I think the main logo would be the (graduated) orange ‘global’ with a black ‘dough’ and graduated orange strapline as shown in the top row of the final version.

So we just need logo guidelines and all file types to use across online, social media, on the truck itself and other hard copy materials eg pull up banners, or printed menus, uniform etc .

As the files will be large file sizes how do you share them? Wetransfer?

Thank you, Niki

decisions.reason: Selecting rev4-02 confirms the result of the revision process but does not modify the requested concept-and-revision process itself.
The final-design selection does not change the existing requirement to provide all file types needed for digital and hard-copy use.
The selected visual design does not change the current requirement to provide logo usage guidelines.
The selected final logo arrangement necessarily establishes colour usage that the brand colour specification must document.
